assets.prompt:
A single little girl from ancient China, about seven years old: the Flame Emperor's daughter Nüwa. Black hair tied in a bun on top of her head, a round friendly face, a red tunic over a red skirt with a yellow apron, simple dark shoes. Standing, three-quarter view turned slightly to the right, arms relaxed at her sides, the whole figure visible from the top of the bun to the shoes. She is isolated in the middle of the board with a wide empty margin of board on every side.

Style: children's picture-book art made entirely of cut pieces of hand-painted tissue paper, matching the paints and paper textures of the attached reference. Inside each piece: bold acrylic brush streaks, sponge mottling and comb-scraped texture in a few rich colours. Crisp scissor-cut edges. Flat, layered collage with no 3D shading and no outlines. Everything sits on a plain, flat, evenly lit cream paper board that fills the whole image. No cast shadows, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers.

The attached image is a cut-paper girl. Make her puppet parts sheet: the same girl taken apart into separate flat cut-paper pieces, laid out on the board like parts before assembly. Pieces: the head with hair, bun and neck; the body (tunic, skirt and apron, without arms and without legs); the left arm with its hand; the right arm with its hand; the left leg with its shoe; the right leg with its shoe. The joint end of every limb (shoulder, hip, neck) is cut straight. Keep every colour, paint and texture exactly as in the attached girl. Every piece is complete, nothing overlaps, and plain board shows between all pieces with clear gaps. Leave a wide empty margin of board around the edges.
